title: Copper or copper-alloy tubing to galvanized steel pipe.
officialText:
Joints between copper or copper-alloy tubing and galvanized
steel pipe shall be made with a brass fitting or dielectric fitting or a dielectric union conforming to ASSE 1079. The copper tubing
shall be soldered to the fitting in an approved manner, and the fitting shall be screwed to the threaded pipe.
